category_title: Students at risk of educational failure with significant instructional and behavioral disengagement
minimal_context: Henri is returning to the classroom to work independently on a worksheet identifying and transcribing letters.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Henri, please start your worksheet. Look at this word here. (Points to the lower-case 'y' in 'yumi') What is the name of the first letter?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Not quite. Just go ahead and copy the letters into the boxes on your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Copies the lower-case letters into the boxes, being very particular about adding the serifs exactly as seen on the worksheet, reproducing the top and bottom horizontal lines for the upper-case 'I'.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep going and finish the rest of the worksheet by yourself.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stops working, sits with his thumb in his mouth, and does not take responsibility for completing the assigned task.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Henri, please start your worksheet. Look at this word here. (Points to the lower-case 'y' in 'yumi') What is the name of the first letter?

STUDENT: l

TUTOR: Not quite. Just go ahead and copy the letters into the boxes on your paper.

STUDENT: (Copies the lower-case letters into the boxes, being very particular about adding the serifs exactly as seen on the worksheet, reproducing the top and bottom horizontal lines for the upper-case 'I'.)

TUTOR: Keep going and finish the rest of the worksheet by yourself.

STUDENT: (Stops working, sits with his thumb in his mouth, and does not take responsibility for completing the assigned task.)
